plain_language: Civil society sharpens AI rule pushback. Chip-IPO cohort stacks filings. Cloud agent toolkits add tenant audit logs.
findings:
Today's evidence consolidates a Saturday-cycle weekend in which every standing-prediction lane gains material reinforcement without any single thread resetting. On policy, the Frontier Model Review Board executive-order opposition stack hardens by two weight-class amici: the Knight First Amendment Institute and EFF file a Saturday-morning amicus letter joining the AI Policy Institute / R Street / Public Knowledge / Lawyers for Civil Justice coalition, demanding at minimum a 60-day public comment window plus a documented State Farm reasoned-decision record over any Defense Production Act Section 708 voluntary-information-sharing pre-release notification regime. Senator Mark Warner's office firms the May 15 classified threshold briefing at 14:00 EDT in S-407 with NIST Director Laurie Locascio, the ODNI cyber lead, and a CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative representative attending; Senator Todd Young's office adds Senator Jacky Rosen to the requesting cohort. White House OSTP signals via a Saturday press-pool note that no signing window opens before May 22, pushing the operative landing into late-May / early-June and preserving the Q3 2026 frame.

The trans-Atlantic cyber-AI regulatory perimeter widens by two jurisdictions in a single weekend. South Korea's Personal Information Protection Commission and Ministry of Science and ICT publish a joint Saturday statement signaling intent to mirror the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity memorandum-of-cooperation under a 90-day domestic-consultation window with formal signature targeted for July; New Zealand's Government Communications Security Bureau confirms it will join Canada CCCS and Australia ASD ACSC as observer with a Q3 2026 mirror commitment. Mistral, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google DeepMind reaffirm participation under sharing-in-confidence terms; Mythos and GPT-5.5 remain the operational threshold across the cohort. The US recognition gap widens by one weekend.

In capital markets, the Cerebras CBRS post-trade Saturday read consolidates as the operative public-market reference: Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and Citi hold their initiation Buys at $165-$185 12-month targets while Bernstein adds a Market-Perform initiation at $172 with sober commentary citing Saudi Aramco Digital MoU dependency as the top single-counterparty concentration risk. The CFO's Saturday investor-Q&A note confirms the 180-day lock-up expires October 28, 2026 with no early-release waiver contemplated for the OpenAI $1B warrant package over ~33M shares — the first explicit public-company-side confirmation of warrant tenor for a frontier-lab chip-supply package. Tenstorrent files a confidential S-1 draft under the JOBS Act EGC framework with public-filing windows opening early August and Hyundai Motor Group + Samsung Foundry retaining co-anchor positions on a fully-closed $3.4B bridge round; Bain Capital Ventures and Fidelity Management join as new investors. SambaNova confirms J.P. Morgan and Citi as joint lead bookrunners alongside Goldman Sachs for an S-1 confidential submission targeted late June at a $7-9B fully-diluted range, with Groq trailing 30-60 days behind pending sovereign-cloud Saudi commitment closure. SEC Corp Fin's Saturday clarifying footnote treats the May 8 Mag-7 sample comment letter on AI-services-revenue measurement basis as generally applicable guidance rather than a Wells-style enforcement signal, and Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, and Evercore ISI lift their probability of a recurring mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence becoming the operative norm into Q3-print territory.

On security, the named-CVE corpus hardens into operational allied procurement language. NHS England's agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist names five disallowed pre-patch versions on NHS-tenant deployments (Ni8mare / n8n CVE-2026-21858, LangGraph CVE-2026-44012, LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188, CrewAI CVE-2026-44352, Haystack CVE-2026-44391) tied to the CISA May 21 federal-civilian KEV-mirroring deadline. Trail of Bits publishes a full red-team write-up on SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) — a sixth distinct agentic-runtime CVE in the same week. Shadowserver day-nine scan drops exposed pre-1.121.0 n8n instances from ~8,300 to ~6,800 (-18.1%) with the German cohort falling below the four-figure mark for the first time; 44% remain unpatched on self-hosted Docker. Censys honeypot exploitation tapers from a 4.8x post-KEV spike to ~2.9x baseline. Microsoft Defender for Cloud's MCP-server threat-detection module quarantines 24% of net-new MCP servers within 30 minutes (up from 19% Friday); Sysdig's weekend addendum reports median time-from-MCP-server-provisioning to first credential-extraction-attempt has fallen to 19 minutes on unprotected estates versus 4.3 hours on Defender-protected tenants; Cisco-Astrix's MCP-server identity gateway co-branded with Defender XDR plus the Microsoft Agent 365 audit ledger reaches 740 enterprise-tenant deployments inside 48 hours. Cross-vendor agentic-AI control-plane visibility now exceeds 65% of new MCP-server provisioning events. The Saturday arxiv preprint 2605.05933 by MIT CSAIL, ETH Zurich, and Anthropic provides a formal-verification framework for per-tenant capability attestation over MCP tool-call graphs and proves a no-cross-tenant-information-leakage property under the gating composition rule — the citable safety theorem framework maintainers can reference.

In the agentic-platform layer, the three-hyperscaler parallel landing now spans both signed-skill provenance and reciprocity-attestation surface. Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog ships its first weekend update adding Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry interop in public preview with per-tenant capability gating under the Foundry tenant-policy schema; AWS Bedrock Agent Registry adds OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry interop in private preview for FedRAMP-Moderate tenants; Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center extends model-card schema coverage to include the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity attestation field. Anthropic's day-two registry telemetry counts 13,800 published skills (+21%) and 891K installs across the second 24 hours, 22 Mythos-class auto-quarantines (8 from JPMorgan Chase, Booz Allen Hamilton, and Mandiant Consulting), with Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 signing the contractual ethics-and-misuse rider over the weekend to lift the gated cohort to 41. Simon Willison's Saturday follow-up praises the per-tenant attestation log as the first vendor-side governance primitive that holds up to sustained audit-trail review. Mistral's DGFiP central-tax-administration win lifts paid Workflows tenancy to 296 with 4.4M daily executions.

On fine-tuning, Unsloth's router-only LoRA recipes get their first community reproduction: a Saturday Hacker News front-page write-up documents a successful end-to-end Kimi K2.6 router-only LoRA run on a single RTX 6000 Ada workstation (96GB VRAM) reporting 14% peak VRAM and 76% accuracy recovery on the in-domain code-generation eval (within the published 71-78% range). Unsloth ships a Saturday changelog adding a quantization-aware router-only LoRA mode targeting 4-bit dynamic-bits-per-parameter that further trims peak VRAM by 19% on Mixtral 8x22B and Llama 4 Behemoth, plus a Hugging Face PEFT compatibility shim for round-trip adapter export. On hardware, AIwire's Saturday three-vendor roadmap reconciliation table aligns Cerebras CS-4 Q1 2027 first-customer (71 PFLOPS dense BF16), Nvidia Vera Rubin H1 2027 NVL576 production-volume, and AMD Helios + MI450 H2 2026 production-ramp (6.2GW commitment book) capacity additions of materially comparable shape. Tenstorrent confirms first production-rack shipments — CoreWeave 8, Lambda 6, Crusoe 4, Hyundai Robotics Metaplant 3 — and Hyundai Robotics Metaplant's 3-rack Tenstorrent Galaxy allocation is now provisioned for Atlas humanoid-policy fine-tuning with the first per-task LoRA fine-tune scheduled Tuesday on the Unsloth router-only recipe. On physical AI, Tesla's Saturday Optimus operations note confirms the first 12 of the 240 internally-allocated Gen 3 units have begun pilot work on the Fremont cell-pickup task within the human-baseline 1.4x cycle-time envelope, with the Stellantis Detroit 60-unit pilot tracking for late-June activation. Boston Dynamics Atlas commercial-roster expansion: Hyundai Steel Dangjin 60 units active on hot-rolled-coil handling, Kia Slovak Zilina paint-line A-pillar first complete shift cycle with no MTBF-impacting incidents, LG Energy Solution Holland Michigan cell-stacking quality-inspection targeted for Monday activation. The four-OEM-adopted humanoid league-table thesis tracks with hard MTBF + cycle-time disclosures pending the IROS / GTC Fall 2026 update.

The agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE corpus is now a six-runtime weekly cadence — Ni8mare / n8n CVE-2026-21858, LangGraph CVE-2026-44012, LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188, CrewAI CVE-2026-44352, Haystack CVE-2026-44391, and Trail of Bits' SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 — with NHS England's named-CVE blocklist tied to the CISA May 21 federal-civilian KEV-mirroring deadline serving as the first allied-jurisdiction sovereign-procurement enforcement linkage. Microsoft Defender's 24% MCP-server quarantine rate within 30 minutes, Sysdig's 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction on unprotected estates versus 4.3 hours on Defender-protected ones, and Cisco-Astrix's 740 enterprise-tenant identity-gateway deployments in 48 hours collectively put a measurable cost on the absence of zero-trust attestation. The Saturday arxiv preprint 2605.05933 proving no-cross-tenant-leakage for per-tenant capability gating, paired with the three-hyperscaler signed-skill / agent-registry / governance-center weekend interop landing and the Knight Institute / EFF amicus stack on the FMRB executive-order frame, is exactly the convergent zero-trust shape the prediction has been building toward.

On the cloud-flagship-API for advanced plus local-LLM for daily standing prediction, the cloud-side multiple now has a publicly-priced AI-accelerator anchor and a structurally-new on-prem fine-tuning compute envelope in the same weekend window. Cerebras CBRS holds Buy at $165-$185 with Bernstein's Market-Perform $172 single-counterparty concentration call adding the first sober buyside marker, the CFO's October 28 lock-up confirmation locks the OpenAI $1B warrant tenor, and Tenstorrent's confidential S-1 + SambaNova's $7-9B fully-diluted range + Groq trailing 30-60 days behind extend the cohort comparable. AIwire's three-vendor roadmap reconciliation aligns Cerebras CS-4, Nvidia Vera Rubin, and AMD Helios + MI450 capacity additions across H2-2026-through-H1-2027 — the cloud substrate's price-discovery primitive is now publicly comparable. On the local leg, the Saturday Hacker News reproduction of the Unsloth router-only Kimi K2.6 recipe at 14% peak VRAM and 76% accuracy recovery on a single RTX 6000 Ada workstation, plus the quantization-aware 4-bit-dynamic mode trimming another 19% VRAM and the Hugging Face PEFT compatibility shim, is a step-change in single-node fine-tuning economics rather than incremental kernel work; Hyundai Robotics Metaplant's 3-rack Tenstorrent Galaxy allocation provisioned for Atlas humanoid-policy LoRA on the Unsloth recipe is the first OEM-side production-deployment evidence. The user's split remains economically viable on both sides.

On the RL/LLM-based forecasting-performance standing prediction, the substrate, governance, and training-stack densify in parallel. The arxiv 2605.05933 capability-attestation framework plus the three-hyperscaler signed-skill registry interop plus Anthropic's 41-enterprise Mythos Preview cohort (Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 added this weekend; JPMorgan Chase, Booz Allen Hamilton, Mandiant already inside) is the audit-and-attestation perimeter an autonomous forecasting agent operating inside an enterprise-grade procurement gate would need. The Cerebras CS-4 Q1 2027 announcement explicitly naming router-only Mixture-of-Experts training plus ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning as the target workload converts the algorithmic primitive into a hardware-roadmap commitment. The Hyundai Robotics Metaplant Atlas LoRA fine-tune scheduled Tuesday on the Unsloth router-only recipe over a 3-rack Tenstorrent Galaxy allocation is the first production OEM-side closed loop between humanoid-policy training and the router-only stack — closing the substrate Pareto frontier the prediction depends on. The four-OEM-adopted humanoid league-table thesis (Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Fremont 12-of-240 active, Boston Dynamics Atlas across Hyundai Steel / Kia Zilina / LG Holland, plus Figure 03 BMW and Apptronik Apollo Mercedes from the standing roster) tracks with hard MTBF + cycle-time disclosures and the IROS / GTC Fall 2026 update window remains the next league-table reset.
